label: 2 November 2026
title: Yamal and Raphinha braces as Barça thrash Alavés 6-1
deck: Hansi Flick records his 100th win. Fermín rejects Manchester United interest. Recovery session with Christensen involved as Aston Villa approaches.

stories.headline: Yamal and Raphinha each score twice as Barça beat Alavés 6-1
stories.summary: Hansi Flick’s side returned to winning ways with a 6-1 victory over Deportivo Alavés at Spotify Camp Nou. Raphinha and Lamine Yamal scored two goals each. Fermín López and Anthony Gordon also found the net.
stories.body: The league leaders, who had lost to Paris Saint-Germain and Real Madrid in the previous week, scored four times before the interval. Raphinha opened the scoring in the eighth minute after a Pedri pass and Fermín square. Fermín doubled the lead in the 23rd minute. Raphinha added his second on 41 minutes and Yamal made it 4-0 in first-half stoppage time. Yamal scored again in the 65th minute after a Gabriel Jesus through ball, with VAR confirming the goal. Gordon chipped the sixth in the 81st minute. Mariano pulled one back for Alavés three minutes later. Attendance was 53,523. The result leaves Barça on 30 points, two clear of Atlético Madrid.

stories.headline: Flick reaches 100 wins in 131 games with club-record win rate
stories.summary: The 6-1 win marked Hansi Flick’s 100th victory as Barcelona manager. He reached the figure in 131 matches, the second-fastest in club history. His win percentage of 76.33% is the highest of any manager with at least 20 games.
stories.body: Only Luis Enrique reached 100 wins faster, in 126 matches. Pep Guardiola needed 139. The club published the figures after the Alavés match. Flick has now won more than three-quarters of his games since arriving in summer 2024. He has two La Liga titles, a Copa del Rey and two Supercopas in that time. In the post-match mixed zone he said he was extremely satisfied and that he liked what he saw. He noted that Alavés defended deep and that the side managed the transitions well.

stories.headline: Brian Fariñas makes first-team debut at right-back
stories.summary: The 20-year-old La Masia midfielder started at right-back against Alavés. With Jules Koundé, Eric García and Xavi Espart unavailable, Hansi Flick moved Fariñas to the flank for his first senior appearance.
stories.body: Fariñas has trained with the first team throughout the autumn. He arrived from Benicarló via Villarreal’s academy and has played mainly in midfield for Barça Atlètic. Frenkie de Jong partnered Pau Cubarsí in central defence. João Cancelo operated on the left. Balde started on the bench. The club published congratulatory posts on Sunday afternoon. Flick had described the youngster as intelligent and ready in the days before the match. No official assessment of his performance has been released beyond the selection itself.

stories.headline: Fermín rejects Manchester United interest and says he wants to stay
stories.summary: Fermín López scored once and assisted twice against Alavés. Afterwards he said he pays no attention to reports linking him with Manchester United and wants to remain at Barcelona for as long as possible.
stories.body: Speaking to the media after the match, the 23-year-old said: “I don’t pay attention to that kind of news. I want to stay here at Barça as long as possible. I hope to end my football career at this club and retire here.” He has six goals and six assists in 13 appearances this season and extended his contract until 2031 earlier in the year. Matteo Moretto and other outlets had reported that Manchester United had enquired about him and Pablo Barrios. The club has not commented on the interest. Fermín was named MVP by several Spanish outlets.

stories.headline: Recovery session at Ciutat Esportiva; Christensen joins part of the group
stories.summary: The squad trained on Sunday morning at the Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper. Starters did recovery work in the gym. Andreas Christensen completed part of the session with the group as he continues his return from a thigh injury.
stories.body: The session began at 11:00 CET. Four Barça Atlètic players also took part: Àlex Campos, Guillem Víctor, Ebrima Tunkara and Hamza Abdelkarim. The club said Monday’s work will focus on preparations for Aston Villa in the Champions League on Tuesday. The first 15 minutes of training will be streamed on Barça Play and YouTube from 11:00, followed by the pre-match press conference with Hansi Flick and a player at 13:00. Kick-off against Aston Villa is 21:00 at Spotify Camp Nou.

stories.headline: Raphinha reaches 15 league goals in 11 matches
stories.summary: Raphinha’s double against Alavés took him to 15 La Liga goals in 11 games. The figure equals a benchmark previously reached by César Rodríguez and Lionel Messi at the same stage of a season.
stories.body: The captain has scored in six of the last seven league matches. He also has three assists this season. SPORT noted that he has already surpassed his total from the whole of last season’s league campaign. Yamal, still 19, scored twice before his 20th birthday. Fermín contributed a goal and two assists. The club highlighted the attacking numbers in its match report. No further individual awards have been announced.

stories.headline: Flick: ‘I liked what I saw’ after the 6-1
stories.summary: Hansi Flick said he was extremely satisfied with the response. He told reporters that the side dominated the first half, created chances by attacking spaces and controlled Alavés’ transitions.
stories.body: In the post-match press conference he added that he does not usually look at the past but is happy with the 100 wins. He singled out Lamine Yamal, Fermín, Raphinha, De Jong and Fariñas. He described the first Clásico win in Madrid as one of his favourite memories with the club. The German had said before the match that the idea of how the team plays would not change. Barça remain top of La Liga.

stories.headline: Barça back on 30 points and two clear of Atlético
stories.summary: The win moves Barcelona to 30 points from 11 league games. Atlético Madrid sit second on 28 after a 2-0 victory at Levante. Real Madrid remain third.
stories.body: Alavés are tenth and have gone seven matches without a league win. The next league fixture for Barça is away to Atlético Madrid on 8 November. Before that, Aston Villa visit in the Champions League on 3 November. The club published its five facts preview for Alavés earlier in the week. No further table-related statements have been issued by the coaching staff.
